title: 顆粒活性碳吸附
summary: 本課以吸附平衡、床層傳質、穿透與再生為主線，從目標物與競爭背景、批次等溫線、空床接觸時間、處理床體積數進入十個相連的技術單元。每單元依機制、數量模型、驗證與失效辨識逐步操作，最後完成包含單位、敏感度及邊界的工程工作單。數值均為原創教學假設，不是特定設施實測或現場操作設定。
summaryEn: This course develops adsorption equilibrium, bed transfer, breakthrough and regeneration through ten connected units, beginning with targets and competing background, batch adsorption isotherms, empty-bed contact time, treated bed volumes. Each unit moves through mechanism, quantitative model, verification and failure diagnosis, ending in a worksheet with units, sensitivity and applicability. All example numbers are original teaching assumptions, not facility measurements or live operating settings.

steps.objective: 辨識 批次等溫線 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。

steps.observation: 原創教學假設：假想 K=2 (mg/g)/(mg/L)^0.5；C=0.10 mg/L；1/n=0.5。模型 q=K C^(1/n)，代入得到 0.63245553 mg/g。適用邊界：同溫度單溶質平衡擬合；不能直接預測多成分動態床壽命。

quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: Cumulative throughput=24000 m³; carbon bed=10 m³. Model BV=Vwater/Vbed gives 2400 bed volumes. Applicability: Bed volumes quantify throughput only; competition and feed concentration change service life. In the offline workbench, select the observation point for performance and data traceability. Plot C/C0 against bed volumes as a breakthrough curve. Retain raw values, units and times, separate predictions from observations, and resolve discrepancies before treating a simulation as field validation.

workedExample.title: 教學算例
workedExample.text: 原創教學假設：Q=500 m³/d；目標物=20 µg/L。模型 L=QC/1000000，代入得到 0.01 kg/d。適用邊界：微克至公斤換算；不可把背景 DOC 當作同一種目標物。
